name: GEORDIE GREEP
description: Geordie Greep performs a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is scheduled for November 14, 2026, and has a duration of 60 minutes.
longDescription:
Geordie Greep is set to perform a concert at Radioclube Agramonte in Porto. The event is classified under Music & Festivals and is open to individuals aged 16 and above.

The concert takes place on November 14, 2026, with a duration of 60 minutes. Tickets are priced at 17€.

Radioclube Agramonte is located at Rua João Martins Branco 180, 4150-430 Porto. The promoter for this event is Radioclube Agramonte.
